title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-09
source: SBD (shn ID 172) with AUD patch by Monte Barry.

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard recording with a strong performance and a memorable Truckin' banter about a missed Here Comes Sunshine segue.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the clear, great‑sounding audio and notes that the band delivered a solid set. A highlight is the on‑stage “conversation” after the 11‑minute stretch of Truckin', where Jerry tries to steer into "Here Comes Sunshine" before being overruled in favor of Playin!. Overall the show feels energetic and well captured.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it gives a 4‑star rating and mentions both excellent sound and strong performance, leading to an overall four‑star assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the audio as "great sound," indicating clear and balanced recording quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, highlighted by a notable stage banter after Truckin' where the band decides against a Here Comes Sunshine segue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Attempted to transition into "Here Comes Sunshine" after Truckin', but was overruled and they moved into Playin! instead.
